reason: I'd love to get my evenings back and stop losing leads, but 'CRM, Google, Microsoft...' doesn't tell me it works with the little tools I actually run on. I'd try the free plan or book the demo, but I'm not paying 99 € a month until I see it follow up a real lead without me babysitting it.
objection: It probably won't plug into the specific tools I use, and then I'm the one doing the copy-pasting at midnight anyway, plus I don't know what 100 credits actually gets me.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the demo connected to my own inbox and tools, chasing up a real lead on its own, with a clear idea of how many tasks 100 credits covers.
